versions.changelog:
Initial release of the video-storyboard-prompt-kit skill.

- Transforms product briefs or creative ideas into production-ready video scripts, shot-by-shot storyboards, detailed AI video prompts, and editing checklists.
- Gathers and clarifies key information such as topic, audience, platform, duration, and assets, only asking for details that change the plan materially.
- Ensures prompts and storyboard maintain consistent appearance, environment, and continuity across all shots.
- Provides editing guidance covering clip selection, transitions, caption placement, media licensing, and content disclosure.
- Includes optional tool recommendations when appropriate, with clear disclosure of affiliations.
- Scope limited to generating production plans; actual video generation or publishing requires explicit user action.
